Home Jurisdiction Documents (a) The following documents have been published in the home jurisdiction of Enbridge and EPI and are attachments to this Form CB: Appendix A: Management Information Circular and Consent Solicitation Statement with respect to Proposed Amendments to the Trust Indenture Governing the EPI Notes (the “Circular”).
